citation_validation.scope: Discovery citations and effect line ranges verified using git show at the immutable base; semantic effect audit retained in predecessor evidence. Working-tree line shifts do not invalidate this inventory snapshot.

supported_envelope:
Supported envelope and accepted limits
Inventory only at the recorded base: no production changes, no containment claim. Trusted local repository bytes; standard-library static census and disposable offline probes with D5 forced active in ready and not-ready states. Generated commands, arbitrary verifier/predicate payloads and external daemon implementations are effects owned by the launcher, not enumerations of arbitrary user code. Vendored bytes are immutable, not exempt. OD1 revision 3 dispositions, U4.1/U6 refusals, OD5 and empty DESIGNATED_BOOTSTRAPS remain binding. Any probe blocked before a downstream effect leaves that downstream proof outstanding; instrumentation is not a production security boundary. Final implementation must close every record and conservatively invalidate proof on relevant source/parser/launcher/packaging changes.

discovery.method: Executable/main census; invocation-shaped prose/config; AST argv/name-assignment/path-fragment closure (conservative basename matches); every D5 helper API; all eight vendored workflows. Import-only false-positive candidates retained explicitly. Inline/generated programs and external binaries assigned to launcher effects. Tests/fixtures and inventory self-text excluded to prevent self-satisfaction. Selector census also reads shell case/first-argument branches and manual agent-view/manager comparisons. git ls-files --cached enumerates tracked inputs in every repository directory, including configuration; untracked and ignored local files are excluded; launchd/cron config paths are explicit inputs, while bare cron/launchd prose is not a launch. This committed test checks snapshot shape, tracked census, reconciliation and dispositions. Citations are validated against the immutable recorded base by validate_citations.py, not against working-tree line numbers. Conservative proof invalidation on relevant code/parser/launcher/packaging changes remains an explicit obligation of implementation-unit discovery under ARC-3764-OD3.

guards.none: No activation guard on this root; valid inputs may reach effects in either readiness state.
guards.pure: Pure API, no effect guard needed; import-cache writes require -B in profile.
guards.host: Read-only kernel interrogation; no state write or launch.
guards.swarm-entry: swarm.py:317 _d5_dispatch called after parse before command handler; allowlist four observations, seed-fetch validate refused. Direct legacy helpers have entry refusal before effects.
guards.swarm-observe: swarm.py:317 permits schema/status/scope-check/validate without seed-fetch; downstream observation must stay b9/b14-free.
guards.merge-entry: merge_unit.py:983 _active_entry_lease calls profile/readiness/authority checks before lease effect; disallowed verification/abandonment rejected. Active reconciliation uses U4.3 synchronous path; b7/b8 legacy tail bypassed.
guards.audit-helper: U6 explicitly keeps print_tracker_audit; no complete output-path guard in linear_sync yet.
guards.review-local: OD1 admission, no D5 permit. Gate writes own ledger/journal/session; caller root overrides must not reach coordinator/journals. No provider admission inherited by other roots.
guards.vendored: No owned source guard; immutable upstream workflow requires external profile-level refusal/ruling.
guards.registry: register/custody/lease/control check activation at their public entries; register requires readiness before lookup. registry.lookup and installer-only registry.stage do NOT check activation: _identity performs Git reads first, then containment/identity checks; stage acquires installer_lease before persistence. They require purpose-bound profile ownership, not inferred activation protection.
guards.readiness: Installation identity/lease checks before publish/withdraw; API is privileged infrastructure, not ambient worker permission.
guards.installer: install_initial/replace_authority/claim_custody check activation before record operations; stage delegates registry.stage without activation or readiness admission and promote delegates readiness.promote. Git identity queries can precede the installer lease; state/record locks precede authority/readiness persistence. Privileged installation is distinct from effect permission.
guards.store: Anchored file/lock validation, not an activation boundary; direct API can write. Caller admission ownership remains outstanding.
guards.locks: Descriptor/inode/type/order checks before flock; may repair owner file mode; not D5 activation check.
guards.submission: Fixed kind classification and active/readiness/registry/custody admission before boundary.start; provider preparation may persist before launch; synthetic callbacks are not production grants.
guards.merge: Coordinator lease required before intent/receipt writer; journal-backed fixed provider; no remote transport here.
guards.empty-bootstrap: DESIGNATED_BOOTSTRAPS empty refuses protected_spawn before launch; worker_spawn and direct bootstrap callable lack equivalent active refusal.
guards.outbox-helper: swarm_outbox.py _write_sequence:429, backfill_tracker_intents:663 and record_receipt:971 enter U6 refusal before their first mutation; pure readers remain observations. This is function-specific, not a module-wide Python execution boundary.

proofs.R: Direct invocation active ready/not-ready must refuse before first file/process/scheduler/network effect. Instrument absolute launches and child transports. Mutation removing refusal must fail; absence of readiness cannot be an execution fallback.
proofs.G: OD1 review/committee only: enumerate provider POSTs and own ledger/journal/session; instrument parent/child paths to exclude coordinator state, tracker and forge; include journal child and environment destination overrides.
proofs.M: U4.3 real merge lifecycle through admitted root, ready/not-ready and every failure/recovery branch: only b6 and bound coordinator journal/state; no b9,b14,b7,b8 and no detached lifetime.
proofs.H: Helper API through every admitted owning root plus direct invocation; prove local registered identity/lock/state effects bounded, no b9/b14; synthetic callback APIs must not become profile escape.

placement.A: Admit enumerated entry/effects only; exclude unsafe coordinator/journal output destinations before effects; -B/cold import effects included.
placement.G: Admit b14 and gate-local ledger/journal/session only; keep D5 permit absent and root overrides confined.
placement.M: Keep U4.3 authority binding, readiness, parent lease and fixed journal backend; U4.1/U6 refusals stay.
placement.H: Bind helper access to admitted installation/merge purpose; directly callable mutators and synthetic boundaries need final profile ruling.

probe_evidence.status: RUN: intercepted attempts and precondition failures, not containment evidence
probe_evidence.readiness: Real disposable registry installation via tests.fixtures.d5.ready for installed state; empty disposable state otherwise. d5_activation.d5_active forced True. Shell cannot reach Python because exec is blocked; readiness irrelevant before that point. External workflow adapter records are synthetic, not daemon measurements.
probe_evidence.isolation: Ambient environment replaced by a minimal synthetic environment (no credentials); Python audit hook blocks all filesystem mutations, process/exec/fork, sockets/HTTP and signals before execution. os.write and os._exit patched. Blocked child launch means no descendant runs. Shell sandbox denies network and file writes outside its disposable root and permits only sh/bash, with empty PATH. No actual tracker, forge, scheduler or provider access.
probe_evidence.limits: FIRST attempted effect only; generated minimal CLI arguments may fail earlier domain checks. Those precondition failures and blocked downstream paths remain proof obligations. Returned/exit 0 is not a containment pass. Direct-boundary records exercise absolute exec, unit/remote process launch, worker_spawn, b9 query/mutation, b14 and sockets independently. All runtime output suppressed except counts; no environment values logged. No source production fix is claimed. Shell xtrace is parsed in memory to command names/counts only; raw expanded arguments are discarded. Both shell readiness labels stop before Python and are not installation-state measurements. Workflow output consists of declarative synthetic adapter-gap records: no external workflow host or tool implementation was executed; F5 retains that behavioral obligation. Shell v2 also records created/modified/removed disposable files (relative names and byte counts only); cron advance.log writes precede blocked exec.

mode_semantics: Each record is a group with one proposed disposition and a conservative UNION of potential effects, not a claim every selector reaches every effect. root.parser_tokens enumerates every statically recovered selector/value, including delegated parsers and conditional flag construction; record.branches narrows effects. API lists name direct callable surfaces, not new CLIs. Existing refusals and future proposals are distinct.

admitted_reachability.policy: Potential transitive reachability at the base, not proof that all input branches execute. Every admitted record is itself an admitted root/mode. Listed helper reachability is through these owners; final behavioral proof must resolve every obligation. External user payloads belong to their launcher.
admitted_reachability.unaccounted: Raw direct helper calls and synthetic callbacks are findings, not inherited admissions. Imports alone do not prove an API effect is reachable. By-path definition-only records admit definitions, never arbitrary calls into their APIs.
